checks.details: All JSON and GeoJSON files under data/research/candidate-trails parse successfully.

All 12 included trails have normalization-handoff.research.json with the required top-level keys, scalar status, open decisions, validation checklist, geometry plan, facility plan, rule warning plan and import order.
Manifest section counts match actual section research files for all 12 included trails.

Shared importer decisions cover distances, geometry, endpoint continuity, topology, partial/self-navigation handling, direction reversal, facilities, rule warnings, overlap dedupe and source currentness for every included trail.
Parking/transit, informal tenting, private/seasonal services, heritage/attractions, hiker-facing rule warnings and overlap dedupe now have explicit shared policies before runtime import.
This prep remains research-only. No runtime app source data or generated public route data is approved for these candidate trails yet.

knownAllowedHeterogeneity.details: Handoff detail shapes vary because the trails came from separate research branches. The strict importer contract is the shared decision file plus the required handoff top-level keys; phase 3 candidate artifacts should normalize detailed blocker/facility/rule records into the candidate artifact schema.
Some handoffs use blocker arrays and some use structured hardBlockers/publicationTimeRechecks. Candidate import reports must emit one normalized blocker list per trail before runtime import.
Hallandsleden, Bohusleden and Nordkalottleden already include substantial geometry artifacts; several other trails still need candidate geometry builds during phase 3.
